## Half year done

Today was supposed to be the Berlin go-live. Instead it's 18 August, decided at the [[Q3 planning offsite]]. Strange to feel relieved about a slip. H1 at work: Atlas late, hired Lieke, team is talking to each other again. H1 at home: Daan gone, flat mine, 10k done in 58:41 on 25 May (goal was under 60!).

## The bathroom

Black spots back on the ceiling above the shower, and the grout by the window. Landlord (Mr. Overmars, never answers email) says "ventilate more". Window is open, fan runs 24/7. Read [[Damp in the bathroom]] and bought a hygrometer for €14: 78% two hours after a shower. That's not me, that's the building. Sent photos plus readings to Overmars on the 27th, WhatsApp this time. Deadline I gave him: 15 July.

## Money check

Redid the numbers after Daan left. Rent alone €1,640, savings down to €350/month. The [[Emergency fund]] is at €7,900, target was 6 months of costs, so ~€14k. Not close. No Kyoto this year then, or a cheap version.
